Пригород — тихое место. Пара депо, пара: The Suburb is a quiet place. A couple of depots, a couple of switches, trains one at a time. Set the switches calmly, nobody is rushing you here.
На Узловой пути сходятся. Слияние — само: On the Junction the tracks converge. A merge is the most dangerous spot on the map: two trains in one cell and your shift is over. Sometimes it is easier to hold a train back for a tick.
Маятник у нас жёлтый: пропустил поезд —: Our Pendulum is yellow: once it lets a train through, it flips by itself. Count who goes first and who goes second.
На Сортировочной стрелки сами знают цвет: At the Sorting Yard the switches know the colours themselves. A train of their colour goes left, the rest go right. The rest is up to you.

Длинные составы занимают две клетки. Гол: Long trains take up two cells. The head has passed, the tail is still on the switch. Mind the tail.
Встречные идут по одному пути. Разъезд —: Oncoming trains share one track. The passing loop is the only place where they part. Whoever waits gets there.
Кольцо крутит поезд, пока стрелка не вып: The Ring spins a train until a switch lets it out. And the line runs over the ring on the bridges — no crash is possible there.
Час пик. Поездов много, интервалы коротк: Rush hour. Lots of trains, short intervals. One wrong switch and the whole timetable is ruined.
Главный диспетчер видит всё сразу: и мая: The Chief Dispatcher sees everything at once: pendulums, counters and long trains. I have done my shift — now it’s yours.
